tool: deckstack-verify (tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py, DS-027) driven by run_golden.py in this directory
fixture_only: Everything under tools/verify/golden/ is a TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Goldens and the calibration are never installed as deck defaults, never shipped in a state file, and never loaded by the daemon: the deck always starts from the empty state (empty-state invariant, docs/00-scope.md). run_golden.py reaches a golden state only by explicit `ds set` writes at check time.
ci: CI never runs the golden checks (hardware-gated, phase 2+). CI runs only `python3 tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py selftest`, which needs no deck and no camera. See docs/90-verification.md.

camera.note: AUKEY PC-W1 at /dev/video2 (never the OBS loopback /dev/video0); override with $DSV_CAMERA or run_golden.py --camera

pose.captured: 2026-11-23, AUKEY PC-W1 at 1280x720, deck left-of-centre, keys panel rotated 90 deg in frame (portrait)
pose.recalibrate_when: camera or deck moved, lens/focus changed, or lighting changed enough that checks fail with stable-state diffs; re-run `run_golden.py --record` (it re-captures cal-frame.jpg, calibration.json, overlay.png and all goldens)

calibration.state_note: all 15 key backlights on + knob/roller LED rings magenta, so calibrate can place the 15 key ROIs (panel hint) and the LED-zone cell masks (led-region)
calibration.produced_by: python3 tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py calibrate --frame tools/verify/golden/cal-frame.jpg --out tools/verify/golden/calibration.json --overlay tools/verify/golden/overlay.png --panel 395,148,205,347 --led-region 150,300,220,260 --orientation 90

goldens.name: key0
goldens.proves: key:0 key-window ROI pixels: every key index is first pinned to #000000 and key:0 is then written (examples/key.png), so the golden pins the key:0 window's backlit pixels against dark neighbours and the ROI mapping - it catches a dead/occluded key window, a wrong ROI mapping or a render change, independent of what the device showed before. LED rings are pinned to static black (this unit ignores mode 'off').
goldens.capture_command: python3 tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py capture --out tools/verify/golden/key0.jpg --settle 800  (after the state above, fresh daemon on hid:)

goldens.name: panel
goldens.proves: the whole keys panel grid: all 15 key-window ROIs plus the `keys` panel ROI are uniformly backlit when every /controls/keys/N/image is written #ffffff (LEDs off). Catches a dead key window, a wrong grid/ROI mapping, or a device-side render change.
goldens.capture_command: python3 tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py capture --out tools/verify/golden/panel.jpg --settle 800  (after the state above, fresh daemon on hid:)

goldens.name: led
goldens.proves: LED colour camera-visible: every key index pinned dark, knobs 0-2 and rollers 0-1 at static #00ff00 light the calibrated led:0 zone green while the keys panel stays dark. Tolerance 20 (min-over-attempts suppresses single-frame glare). Faders do not exist on this deck.
goldens.capture_command: python3 tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py capture --out tools/verify/golden/led.jpg --settle 800  (after the state above, fresh daemon on hid:)

check_command: python3 tools/verify/golden/run_golden.py [--only key0,panel,led] [--keep DIR]   # exit 0 pass, 7 mismatch
record_command: python3 tools/verify/golden/run_golden.py --record   # deliberate regeneration of goldens + calibration only
harness_check_equivalent: python3 tools/verify/deckstack_verify.py check --expected tools/verify/golden/key0.jpg --calibration tools/verify/golden/calibration.json --tolerance 20 --settle 800 --keep /tmp/key0-actual.jpg   # capture + compare in one step, exit 0/7
